title: Guneku Agro CIG opens its farm to buyers: chickens, chicks, ducks, pigs and manure
excerpt: In a Fondom Studios video of 16 October 2026, the manager of the Guneku Agro CIG — a professional veterinarian — showed what the farm offers, and said the layers should begin laying around December.
sourceNote: Written fresh on 17 October 2026 from the Fondom Studios video published on Facebook on 16 October 2026 and its caption. What is listed is what the CIG advertised in that video; it is not an independent count of stock. The order number is the one the CIG published for enquiries and orders.
body:
Six months after its launch at Ngong Quarter, the Guneku Agro Common Initiative Group has invited buyers to the farm. In a video published by Fondom Studios on 16 October 2026, the CIG's manager — described as a professional veterinarian — takes the camera round the site and introduces what is on offer.

What the CIG is offering

  • Chickens for occasions.
  • Young chicks for people who want to raise their own.
  • Ducks — known locally as duck fowl.
  • Pigs, which the CIG's April record listed as planned.
  • Manure, at an affordable price, for farmers who would otherwise buy it in Bamenda.

The layers are expected to start laying eggs around December 2026.

These are the offerings the CIG advertised in the video. Availability on a given day is for the CIG to confirm.

Orders

For enquiries and orders the CIG published the number 673 536 278.

The full record of the CIG — its registration, governance, membership pricing and what it has announced — is on the Guneku Agro CIG page.

Source

Fondom Studios, video of 16 October 2026. Watch it on Facebook.
